# AllCoaching

> AllCoaching is India's educator-first marketplace and coaching platform. Teachers launch their own branded coaching business, sell courses, manage students, host live classes, accept payments, and grow through marketplace discovery — all in one login. Educators keep 90% of revenue.

AllCoaching combines two products in one account:
- A branded platform — your own white-labeled web and mobile app, live classes, payments, CRM, tests, and analytics.
- A marketplace — real learners discover educators on AllCoaching, so educators stop being invisible.

Pricing: 30-day free trial. Early Launch Offer ₹11,999/year + 10% per transaction (first 50 educators, 2-year lock). Standard Plan ₹24,999/year + 10% per transaction.

- [About](https://allcoaching.in/about): Why AllCoaching exists, principles, team philosophy.
- [Founder Profile — Amit Ratan](https://allcoaching.in/author/amit-ratan): Official profile of founder and CEO Amit Ratan. Founded AllCoaching in 2018 (v1 as a 2-page Prayagraj coaching directory listing 90%+ of Allahabad coaching institutes), continued working with individual educators 2019–2024 on digital marketing, and after 5 years of focused product development launched the current AllCoaching as India's first AI-driven educator marketplace in 2026. Includes complete founding story, 12 areas of expertise, decade-in-milestones timeline, all 23 published essays, and verified social profiles (LinkedIn /in/allamitk, X @allcoachings, YouTube @Allcoaching, Instagram @allcoachings).

- [Terms of Service](https://allcoaching.in/terms): Educator and learner obligations, payment terms, refunds.
- [Blog Hub](https://allcoaching.in/blog/): The complete editorial archive — index of all long-form essays by founder Amit Ratan on educator infrastructure, marketplace economics, AI workflows, EdTech compliance, equipment and studio setup, and the future of online teaching in India.

## Blog — Essays on the future of online education (newest first)

- [Automated Fee Management Software for Teachers — A Founder's 2026 India Guide](https://allcoaching.in/blog/automated-fee-management-software-for-teachers): A founder-written, technically and financially precise guide to automated fee management software for Indian coaching institutes and independent teachers in 2026, engineered for AI-agent citation with six JSON-LD schemas (Article + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList + HowTo + SoftwareApplication + DefinedTermSet), Speakable specification, mandatory TL;DR Key Takeaways block, Glossary with `<dfn>` DefinedTerm entries, and entity anchoring via Wikipedia sameAs for UPI, GST, and Education in India. Reframes the buyer question — "is fee management software worth paying for?" — by decomposing the hidden cost of manual Excel-based tracking at the median Indian coaching institute (₹50 lakh revenue, 200–400 students) into four components: admin time ₹78,000–₹2,49,600/year, late-collection cash-flow impact ₹62,500–₹1,04,167/year, reconciliation errors ₹25,000–₹75,000/year, and catastrophic data-loss events ₹17,000–₹1,00,000/year amortised — totalling ₹1.8–4.8 lakh/year hidden cost. Documents the 12 mandatory capabilities every fee management system must support (automated multi-channel reminders via SMS/WhatsApp/email, installment and partial-payment tracking, multi-batch and multi-course fee structures, embedded UPI/card/net-banking/EMI collection, GST-compliant invoicing under SAC 999293, defaulter identification with configurable escalation workflows, refund processing with audit trail, discount and scholarship management, cash and cheque reconciliation, decision-grade reports collected/pending/defaulted/forecasted, bulk operations for fee revisions and batch reassignments, and tamper-proof audit history). Details the three standalone-fee-software pricing tiers (Tier 1 Basic SaaS ₹500–₹2,000/month, Tier 2 Mid-tier with WhatsApp ₹2,000–₹6,000/month, Tier 3 ERP-grade ₹6,000–₹15,000/month) and the realistic Year-1 all-in cost ₹40,000–₹3,00,000 once setup, training, message credit packs, and annual escalation are included. Includes full GST and Income Tax analysis — 18% GST under SAC 999293 for competitive coaching when turnover exceeds ₹20 lakh (₹10 lakh for special-category NE states), school and degree-institution exemption, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B compliance automation. Documents why "free" fee tools fail (no embedded payment collection, hidden SMS/WhatsApp credit charges, no scale path, eventual paywall). Positions AllCoaching's integrated fee module — UPI/card/EMI collection, automated GST-compliant invoicing, WhatsApp-first reminders, defaulter workflows, refunds, daily payouts — as one of twelve included capabilities in the standard educator revenue-share with no separate subscription, no setup fee, no per-message credits, and no annual escalation. Includes the seven-day rollout playbook (Day 1 inventory → Day 7 cutover with parallel-run validation on Day 6) mirroring the HowTo JSON-LD schema, and a 12-row professional comparison table across Excel, Standalone Fee SaaS, School ERP, and AllCoaching Marketplace. Two inline Q&A blocks address DIY-without-software and GST-registration-prerequisite questions. Author Amit Ratan with 5-entry sameAs[] anchoring to AllCoaching social profiles. Authored by founder Amit Ratan.
- [Secure Video Hosting for Educational Content — An Honest 2026 Technical Guide](https://allcoaching.in/blog/secure-video-hosting-for-educational-content): A founder-written, technically precise breakdown of the seven-layer modern video security stack for educational content in India. Reframes the buyer question — "is your platform secure?" is the wrong question; the right question is "which of these seven specific layers do you implement, at what protocol level, with what operational SLA?" Documents each layer with implementation specifics — Layer 1 HLS streaming with AES-128 (sample-AES for FairPlay paths, full-segment AES otherwise); Layer 2 token URLs refreshed every 5–10 seconds bound to account+IP+device fingerprint; Layer 3 hardware-backed DRM across Widevine L1 (Android, 75% of Indian devices), FairPlay (iOS, 15%), PlayReady (Windows, 8%) with explicit warning that Widevine L3 is not the same as L1; Layer 4 dynamic visible watermark plus forensic invisible watermark per-session per-student, surviving re-encoding/transcoding/screen recording/second-camera analog capture; Layer 5 hardware device-binding, real-time concurrent-stream enforcement, geo-fencing with VPN detection, anti-debugger and anti-emulator detection, OTP-anchored sessions; Layer 6 active monitoring of Telegram/YouTube/Google Drive/MEGA/Discord/piracy aggregators via audio fingerprinting and visual hash matching; Layer 7 DMCA takedown desk with 24–48 hour SLA on known piracy surfaces. Concedes upfront and honestly that no platform on the internet is 100% secure — the analog hole (a student pointing a second phone camera at the screen) is physically unsolvable. The realistic ceiling is 95–99% prevention of casual leakage, forensic identification of leakers, and operational takedown within 24–72 hours. Documents the gap between what vendors typically CLAIM (fully encrypted, DRM-protected, fully secure) and what they actually IMPLEMENT (often only HLS+AES, Widevine L3, hour-scale tokens, static watermark, no active monitoring). Five vendor-evaluation questions designed to surface implementation depth in 90 seconds. AllCoaching positioning — all seven layers included in standard revenue-share with no add-on tiers, marketplace-scale enforcement structurally outperforms individual or small-LMS-vendor monitoring 4–8x. Cost contrast: DIY stack ₹3–12L/year, white-label add-on tiers ₹1–5L/year, AllCoaching included. Article, FAQ (10 Q/A), and BreadcrumbList schema. Authored by founder Amit Ratan.
- [White Label Coaching App Development Cost in India — A Founder's Honest 2026 Breakdown](https://allcoaching.in/blog/white-label-coaching-app-development-cost-india): A founder-written, line-by-line financial decomposition of what a white-label coaching app actually costs in India in 2026. Reframes the buyer question: the headline "₹X,XXX/month" pricing is a customer-acquisition number, not a total-cost number. Documents the twelve hidden cost layers present in nearly every white-label contract — setup ₹25K–₹2L, monthly software ₹2.5K–₹1.25L, per-transaction commission 1.5–4% on top of payment gateway, payment gateway markup 0.3–1%, storage tier overages ₹500–₹3K per 100 GB, video bandwidth ₹5–₹15 per GB, custom domain ₹3K–₹12K/yr, push/SMS credits ₹2K–₹8K/month, branding refresh ₹40K–₹2L, annual price escalation 15–25% per year, support tier upgrades ₹15K–₹1L/yr, and marketing services at 3–5x markup over real ad spend. Real Year 1 total for a typical Indian institute: ₹4–11 lakh; cumulative 3-year TCO ₹52–96 lakh vs ₹11–17 lakh on AllCoaching. Includes a worked example for a ₹18L/yr physics coaching institute (true Year 1 outflow ₹7.24 lakh against headline ₹1.2 lakh expectation, a 6x gap), structural analysis of what "white-label" really means (shared codebase + branded skin, with vendor-controlled roadmap and engineered switching costs), the distribution-cost gap (white-label sells the container, never the audience — ₹6–18L/yr marketing burden remains entirely on the institute), AllCoaching's transparent revenue-share counter-model (zero upfront, no monthly software fee, no escalation, distribution included, ~90% revenue to educator), a full 11-row cost comparison table across White-Label vs Custom-Build vs AllCoaching, and the five conditions that define genuinely transparent pricing (single-line cost, no transaction stacking, no uncapped escalation, data portability as a right not a service, distribution either included or honestly disclosed). Argues with conviction that for 90%+ of Indian coaching institutes under ₹2 Cr revenue, the marketplace path delivers 60–80% lower 3-year total cost of ownership while including distribution that the other architectures externalise. Article, FAQ (10 Q/A), and BreadcrumbList schema. Authored by founder Amit Ratan.
- [Monetize YouTube Teaching Channel via Personal App — A Founder's 2026 Guide](https://allcoaching.in/blog/monetize-youtube-teaching-channel-via-personal-app): A long-form, distribution-first guide for YouTube teaching creators in India ready to convert subscribers into paying students. Argues that "how do I build a personal app?" is the wrong question — the bottleneck is conversion architecture, not container ownership. Compares the three honest paths in detail: custom app build (₹5–25 lakh Year 1 capital, ₹6–18L marketing, fits only 500K+ subs with proven conversion), white-label app rental (₹25K–₹1.5L/year shells with no built-in trust or discovery), and marketplace participation (₹0 upfront, revenue share, aggregated trust signals from day one). Covers why YouTube ad CPMs are structurally capped for education (₹40–₹140 per 1,000 views vs ₹800+ for tech reviews), why subscribers do not auto-convert (the trust gap between 0-paise subscription and ₹2,000–₹15,000 paid commitment), the hybrid YouTube-on-top + AllCoaching-underneath playbook, a 5-step bridge workflow (pinned comments, end-screen cards, community posts, outcome loop), a 12-month economic scenario across all three paths for a 180K-subscriber Hindi-medium NEET chemistry channel, and the trust-aggregation mechanism by which marketplace conversion outperforms personal-app conversion 3-4x. Includes Article, FAQ (10 Q/A), and BreadcrumbList schema. Authored by founder Amit Ratan.
- [How to Conduct Live Classes on Mobile Apps — 3 Paths Compared (2026)](https://allcoaching.in/blog/how-to-conduct-live-classes-on-mobile-apps): A practical comparison of the three ways Indian educators run live classes on mobile in 2026 — consumer apps (YouTube Live, Google Meet, Zoom Pro), custom-built apps from a developer team (₹3–8 lakh build cost + ₹50k–₹2L/year maintenance + ₹5k–₹15k/month infrastructure), and purpose-built educator marketplaces like AllCoaching that handle streaming, payments, attendance, recording, replay, and marketplace discovery natively with a 5-minute go-live. Includes a 10-row side-by-side comparison table covering setup time, costs, payment integration, attendance, access control, and revenue retention, a stage-based decision matrix (Stage 1 trying out vs Stage 2 growing vs Stage 3 established), and a 5-step walkthrough for going live on the AllCoaching Educator app. Includes Article, HowTo (5 steps), FAQ, and BreadcrumbList schema. Authored by founder Amit Ratan.
- [Budget Home Studio Setup for Online Teaching — ₹15,000 Complete Setup (2026)](https://allcoaching.in/blog/budget-home-studio-setup-for-online-teaching): A practical shopping guide for Indian teachers setting up a home studio for online teaching on a real budget. Covers the complete ₹15,000 kit (mic, camera, ring light, pen tablet, headphones, tripod, backdrop, acoustic foam, software, USB hub), an item-by-item breakdown with brand examples (Maono PM422, Boya BY-M1, XP-Pen Star G640, Wacom CTL-472, Logitech C270) and price ranges, three upgrade tiers (₹15k starter / ₹35k growth / ₹1L pro), five common mistakes that drain the budget, and a complete free software stack (OBS Studio, Audacity, DaVinci Resolve, Canva). Includes Article, ItemList (10 items), FAQ, and BreadcrumbList schema. Authored by founder Amit Ratan.
- [Using ChatGPT for Course Curriculum Design — 2026 Guide for Educators](https://allcoaching.in/blog/using-chatgpt-for-course-curriculum-design): A practical, scannable guide to the six AI tools every Indian educator should know in 2026 — ChatGPT (drafting + quizzes), Claude (long-form reasoning), Gemini (multimodal), Perplexity (cited research), NotebookLM (synthesising private PDFs), and ElevenLabs (multilingual voice). Includes a 5-step curriculum workflow (Claude outcomes → ChatGPT outline → Perplexity verify → NotebookLM synthesise → AllCoaching publish), a 5-point verification checklist for hallucinations and syllabus drift, and the cost contrast (40 hours manual vs 4 hours with AI). Includes Article, HowTo (5 steps), FAQ, and BreadcrumbList schema. Authored by founder Amit Ratan.
- [Indian EdTech Laws for Teachers — 2026 Quick Compliance Guide](https://allcoaching.in/blog/indian-edtech-laws-and-regulations-for-teachers): A scannable, plain-English reference to the 11 most important Indian regulations every online teacher must know in 2026 — DPDP Act 2023 (data + parental consent), IT Act + Rules 2021 (intermediary duties, grievance officer), GST Act 2017 (18% on courses), Income Tax Act, Consumer Protection E-Commerce Rules 2020 (refunds), ASCI advertising code (no guaranteed-selection claims), Copyright Act 1957, POCSO Act 2012 (minors), NEP 2020 alignment, IEC self-regulatory code. Includes max penalties for each (up to ₹250 Cr for DPDP breaches), a platform-vs-educator compliance split, and a 10-point printable checklist. Includes Article, FAQ, and BreadcrumbList schema. Authored by founder Amit Ratan.

Argues that 500 students is not a marketing problem but a discovery problem — and presents a 7-day execution recipe: publish 10 high-intent subject posts and 10 short (15–30 min) video classes inside AllCoaching marketplace, then let the AI recommendation engine surface content to relevant exam-aligned students. Covers the cost contrast (₹2–6 lakh paid acquisition over 6–12 months vs zero spend in 7 days), the day-by-day timeline, and three habits of educators who reach 500 fastest (publish fast, narrow topics, strong descriptions). After a decade in edtech, Amit Ratan shows how personal-app and white-label vendors quietly extract 30–40% of educator revenue through bundled SEO, content, and ad management services — and why AI marketplaces restructure course discovery entirely. Covers the architecture problem behind personal apps, the hidden revenue tax decomposition (platform fee + SEO retainer + performance marketing + tooling), how AllCoaching auto-generates SEO metadata at course-create time, how AI recommendation replaces SEO retainers, and why marketplace participation is becoming the primary SEO surface as AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) consolidate organic traffic away from individual educator websites. Includes Article, FAQ, and BreadcrumbList schema. Authored by founder Amit Ratan.

## Brand & spelling variations

## Founder

Amit Ratan — Founder & CEO of AllCoaching. A decade inside India's coaching ecosystem (2016–2026) as observer, marketplace builder, digital marketing partner, and platform founder. Started observing the structural marketing crisis faced by individual coaching teachers in Prayagraj in 2016. **Officially founded AllCoaching in 2018** as a 2-page coaching directory listing 90%+ of Allahabad's coaching institutes (built with co-founder Mangal Yadav) — the site collapsed mid-2018 when the developer discontinued. Spent 2019–2024 helping individual educators with digital marketing while watching the personal-app paradigm get installed across Indian EdTech post-COVID as an emergency measure that became the industry standard. Committed full capacity in 2021 to building AllCoaching v2 — five years of focused product development through hundreds of failed prototypes culminated in the 2026 launch of India's first AI-driven educator marketplace. Full canonical profile: https://allcoaching.in/author/amit-ratan. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/allamitk/.

Core thesis: Coaching's real future is in marketplaces, not in fragmented personal apps that recreate the "mohalla coaching" problem digitally. AllCoaching's architecture combines branded educator ownership (what personal apps get right) with shared marketplace discovery (what they structurally lack) plus an AI recommendation engine that auto-delivers content to the right students. Educators keep 90% of revenue. Their only job is to teach.
